plugins.name: Blog RSS Sync
plugins.description: Automatically syncs your latest blog posts via RSS using GitHub Actions.
plugins.author: cmduyeen
plugins.workflow_content:
name: Sync Latest Blog Posts

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs once a day at 02:00 UTC to keep commit history clean
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-readme-with-blog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch latest blog posts
        uses: gautamkrishnar/blog-post-workflow@v1
        with:
          feed_list: "{{BLOG_RSS_URL}}"
          max_post_count: 5
          commit_message: "chore: update latest blog posts"
plugins.snippet:
## Latest Blog Posts

<!-- BLOG-POST-LIST:START -->
<!-- Automatically updated by .github/workflows/blog-rss-sync.yml -->
<!-- BLOG-POST-LIST:END -->

plugins.name: Contribution Snake Animation
plugins.description: Generates an animated SVG snake eating your contribution graph daily via Platane/snk.
plugins.author: cmduyeen
plugins.workflow_content:
name: Generate Contribution Snake

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 1 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Generate github-contribution-grid-snake.svg
        uses: Platane/snk@v3
        with:
          github_user_name: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          outputs: |
            dist/github-contribution-grid-snake.svg
            dist/github-contribution-grid-snake-dark.svg?palette=github-dark

      - name: Push snake SVGs to the output branch
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-github-pages@v4
        with:
          target_branch: output
          build_dir: dist
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
plugins.snippet: ## Contribution Snake

plugins.name: YouTube RSS Sync
plugins.description: Automatically lists your latest YouTube videos via channel RSS feed.
plugins.author: cmduyeen
plugins.workflow_content:
name: Sync Latest YouTube Videos

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-readme-with-youtube:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch latest YouTube videos
        uses: gautamkrishnar/blog-post-workflow@v1
        with:
          comment_tag_name: "YOUTUBE"
          feed_list: "https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id={{YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID}}"
          max_post_count: 5
          commit_message: "chore: update latest YouTube videos"
plugins.snippet:
## Latest YouTube Videos

<!-- YOUTUBE:START -->
<!-- Automatically updated by .github/workflows/youtube-rss-sync.yml -->
<!-- YOUTUBE:END -->
